name: rle_huffman
description: Run-length encoding plus a deterministic Huffman coder, combined into a pack/unpack compression pipeline.
bugs: rle_encode() iterates over the whole text instead of text[1:], so the first run is counted one too many
rle_decode() overwrites the run length with the latest digit, breaking multi-digit counts
build_codes() gives the only symbol of a one-symbol text an empty code
